subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw `[[...]]` button JSON in model final text as a fallback for Gemini, or require Gemini/provider prompting to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the gap, but accepting a parser creates a new model-output fallback syntax across prompt, final-reply, transcript, and Telegram presentation boundaries.

options.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
options.body: Allow constrained raw-button extraction only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget to typed routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the issue focused on making Gemini use `message(action=send)` with structured presentation buttons.

options.title: Defer for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not accept implementation work until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
recommendation.body: Allow constrained raw-button extraction only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses the typed presentation contract and Telegram button rendering paths where recent mainline history points most strongly.
